title: Cocktails & Cannoli: Boston's North End Dessert Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Please note we try to keep public tours to groups of 12 or less, so we cannot take large group bookings through TripAdvisor. We are happy to accommodate private and custom tours or larger parties on our public tours depending on availability, please contact us (text is fastest).
PLEASE ADVISE ANY DIETARY REQUIREMENTS IN NOTES AT THE TIME OF BOOKING
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately

Gluten free options are available. We are happy to accommodate dietary needs to the best of our ability, but please be aware not every location is completely allergen free and some tastings are fixed. The cannoli in particular are NOT made in nut free facilities.
The tour usually lasts between 2 and 2.5 hours and we walk for approximately 1.5 miles (2.4 kilometers).
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
BUT FIRST, DESSERT!

Do dessert before dinner when you join us for Cocktails & Cannoli, an all inclusive walking food tour of Boston’s North End.

Skip the infamous lines to taste delicious drinks and classic cannoli, and sample the best sweets the North End has to offer. Not to mention the Paul Revere House and Old North Church along the way!

To top it all off, our local tour guides will sprinkle in fascinating historic knowledge, fun cultural facts, and culinary tidbits.
